photo.aiFailed: The AI cutout could not run here, so the quick cutout is used instead.
photo.depthDone: Shaped with depth from {model}: cushions, arms and backs come forward as in the photo.
photo.depthFailed: The depth could not be worked out here, so the piece gets a soft rounded shape instead.
photo.detectUnavailable: Detection is not available here. Pick the kind yourself.
photo.makeModelHint: About a minute. The cutout goes to a 3D service that makes up the back and sides to match; this is the only step that leaves your browser.
photo.modelDone: Full 3D model ready. Its own proportions set the depth and height; turn it in the room to see every side.
photo.modelFailed: The model could not be made this time. The photo version is still here.
photo.modelLimit: Today’s allowance of full models is used up. Try again tomorrow.
photo.noMatch: No close match in the catalog for this kind.
photo.notSure: Not sure what this is (closest: {kind}, {pct}%). Pick the kind yourself.
photo.nothingLeft: Nothing is left. Raise the tolerance, restore some of the picture, or try the AI cutout.
photo.private: The cutout and its depth are worked out in your browser; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
photo.shapeGuess: Guess from the shape: {kind}. Detect uses a small image model ({size}).
photo.slanted: The underside looks slanted, as if shot from an angle. It will still work, but a straight-on photo sits better.
photo.tip1: Shoot straight on, at the height of the piece
photo.tip2: Good, even light, no harsh flash
photo.tip3: The whole object in the frame with a little space around it
photo.tip4: A plain wall or floor behind it helps the cutout
photo.title: Add something from a photo
photo.unreadable: That file could not be read as a picture
photo.warn.blurry: The photo looks a little blurry. If you can, shoot again with steadier hands or more light.
photo.warn.small: This photo is quite small, so the piece may look soft up close. A larger photo helps.

settings.about: Meu Ambiente lets you plan and furnish rooms in 3D, right in your browser.
settings.appearance.hint: Only the panels change; the room keeps its own light.
settings.controls: Drag the room to look around, scroll to zoom, right-drag to slide. Select a piece and press R to turn it, D to copy it, Delete to remove it. ⌘Z undoes.
settings.credits.text: Furniture models, surface textures and the window views come from Poly Haven and are in the public domain (CC0). The AI models, libraries and fonts below are free to use, commercially too, under the licences shown. Everything else was made for Meu Ambiente.
